title: evoke.toml
description: A project: the reflexes you installed, their settings, and the adapter that decides. Reference: https://evoke.build/manual/reference/files.html.

adapter.description: The adapter that answers, by name. Resolved only against evoke's built-ins, never from a path.

reflexes.description: local name = where the reflex comes from. The local name is what the classifier reads and the overlay's file name.

config.description: Per reflex, the settings its manifest declares under [config]. Secrets are referenced, never stored.

env.description: The environment variable holding the value; the only way to set a secret.

adapters.description: Settings per adapter, under its name. A table for an unselected adapter is inert.

gate.description: Overrides of Jev's calibrated thresholds; each number means P(correct). read may not exceed write.

replay.description: The recorded adapter takes no settings yet; EVOKE_ANSWERS names its recording.

local_name.description: A reflex's local name. none, unstated, fits and weave are reserved.

anyOf.description: owner/repo[/dir][@tag] on GitHub. Unpinned, update moves it; @tag pins it.
<git url>[#dir][@tag]; https and ssh only, a user before the host allowed, never a credential.
A local reflex directory, relative to this file. Never locked; its effect is its own.
